summary: PDF Export Dashboard Overview - All 16 tests PASSED. All 3 reported issues have been fixed: (1) Charts/graphs now included as inline SVG elements, (2) White background (#ffffff) instead of dark theme, (3) Frontend uses iframe for print dialog instead of window.open.

test_1_endpoint_returns_html.description: GET /api/report/dashboard-overview returns valid HTML response with text/html content-type

test_2_white_background_not_dark.description: Body CSS has 'background: #ffffff' - dark theme color #0f172a is NOT used

test_3_contains_inline_svg_charts.description: HTML contains multiple <svg> elements for inline charts

test_4_acwr_gauge_svg_visualization.description: ACWR gauge rendered as SVG with circle, stroke-dasharray attributes

test_5_velocity_zones_horizontal_bars.description: Velocity zones (Low Int, HID Z3, HSR Z4, Sprint Z5) rendered as SVG bars

test_6_metric_cards_structure.description: Metric cards present with proper CSS classes (metric-card, metric-value, metric-label)

test_7_all_layers_render.description: All 5 layers (load, summary, status, neuro, risk) render with proper section headers

test_8_load_layer_only.description: Filtering with layers=load only renders Load Intelligence section

test_9_summary_layer_only.description: Filtering with layers=summary only renders Smart Summary section

test_10_report_header_structure.description: Report header with title 'DASHBOARD REPORT' present

test_11_print_css_media_query.description: @media print styles included with print-color-adjust for proper PDF colors

test_12_no_dark_theme_colors.description: No dark theme colors (#0f172a, #1e1b4b) in base CSS styles

test_15_report_renders_without_error.description: Report renders HTTP 200 without server errors

test_16_charts_have_svg_structure.description: SVG charts have proper viewBox and preserveAspectRatio attributes

issue_1_charts_not_included.before: Only text/numbers exported to PDF, charts were rendered via react-native-svg
issue_1_charts_not_included.after: Charts rendered as inline SVG elements in HTML - ACWR gauge, velocity zone bars, line charts all embedded
issue_1_charts_not_included.verification: HTML contains <svg> elements with <circle>, <rect>, <polyline> for various chart types

issue_2_dark_background.before: Dark background (#0f172a) from app theme printed in PDF
issue_2_dark_background.after: body { background: #ffffff } - white background for printable report
issue_2_dark_background.verification: Body CSS verified to have #ffffff background, no dark colors in base styles

issue_3_window_open_new_tab.before: window.open() opened HTML in new browser tab
issue_3_window_open_new_tab.after: Hidden iframe created, HTML written to iframe, iframe.contentWindow.print() called for native print dialog
issue_3_window_open_new_tab.verification: Frontend data.tsx lines 426-441 use iframe approach, no window.open() calls present

context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF export endpoint GET /api/report/dashboard-overview working correctly. Key features: (1) Inline SVG charts for gauges, bar charts, line charts, (2) White background CSS for printing, (3) Layer filtering via ?layers= parameter, (4) Language support via ?lang=pt or ?lang=en. Frontend uses hidden iframe for native print dialog on web platform.
